title: About Us
headings: About Us
content: About Us The Finance Department is responsible for the financial administration and management of the State. Its key functions include preparation of the Budget, examination of tax proposals, management of State borrowings and Government guarantees, framing of financial rules, monitoring of receipts, expenditure and fiscal balances, and regulating pay, leave and service conditions of State Government employees. It also ensures proper financial discipline, accountability and efficient use of public funds. Our Team Our Organisations Our Performance Dr. Vijay Kumar D, IAS Commissioner & Secretary Finance Department Shri. Ramakrishna Chitturi, IAS Joint Secretary Finance Department

title: Branches | Finance Department Government of Meghalaya
headings: Directorate General of Training (DGT) | Directorate of Jan Shikshan Sansthan (DJSS) | National Council for Vocational Education and Training (NCVET) | National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)
content: Directorate General of Training (DGT) The Directorate General of Training (DGT) in Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship is the apex organisation for development and coordination at National level for the programmes relating to vocational training including Women's Vocational Training. Directorate of Jan Shikshan Sansthan (DJSS) The Directorate of Jan Shikshan Sansthan (DJSS), which is a sub-ordinate office of MSDE, is assigned responsibility of monitoring and supervision of the JSS Scheme. DJSSs implements JSS Scheme through the network of Jan Shikhan Sansthans NGOs. National Council for Vocational Education and Training (NCVET) The National Council for Vocational Education and Training (NCVET) was established by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Government of India, vide Gazette Notification No. SD-17/113/2017-E&PW dated 5th December 2018, as a regulatory body, by subsuming the functions and responsibilities of NCVT and NSQF. National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) The National Skill Development Corporation India (NSDC) was setup as a one of its kind, Public Private Partnership Company with the primary mandate of catalysing the skills landscape in India.

title: About Us | Finance Department Government of Meghalaya
content: Finance Department The Role and function of Finance Department are laid down in the Rules of Executive Business. The department is primarily responsible for the financial administration and management of the State Finances. Some the main functions of the department are preparation of budget and statement of estimated revenues and expenditure to be laid down before the State Legislature; Examination of the proposals for increase or reduction of taxes; state borrowings and provision of Government Guarantees against loans raised by PSUs and otherentities; laying down of appropriate financial rules for guidance of other department that are responsible for maintenance of proper accounts and action to enforce accountability on such matters; preparation of estimates of receipts and disbursements and keeping watch on State Government fiscal balances, ways and means operations etc.; framing of various rules regulating the pay, leave of person in service of the state Government and rules regulating the number, grading or cadre emolument of posts; laying down of appropriate financial rules for guidance of all departments and other entities etc.

title: Finance Audit & Funds Branch | Finance Department Government of Meghalaya
headings: Audit Committees constituted in the Department | Matter related to various Funds dealt by the Department | Other Matters dealt by the Department: | Key Contacts
content: Finance Audit & Funds Branch Finance (AF) as the same suggests deals in matters relating to Audit and Funds. Audit matters include Inspection Report, Draft Paragraphs, C&A.G. Reports, Arrear in accounts of PSUs. The Department acts as a monitoring authority in these matters and all correspondences regarding these matters are recorded in the Department. The Department also issues relevant instruction to the Departments in connection with these matters. Audit Committees constituted in the Department Audit Committee Meetings: The Department deputes a representative to the Audit Committee Meetings for settlement of Inspection Reports. DAAC (Departmental Audit & Accounts Committee): The Department issues instructions to all Departments to convene meetings and to settle matters relating to Audit. SAAC (State Audit & Accounts Committee): Under the Chairmanship of the Chief Secretary, a State Level Committee meeting is convened every year with the Principal Accountant General (Audit) for settlement of Draft Paras relating to Audit of various Departments. Matter related to various Funds dealt by the Department G.P.F.: The Department conveys approval in respect of GPF applications in accordance with the Meghalaya GPF Rules 2020 C.E.A. (Children Education Advance): The Department provides funds for allotment of Children Education Advance to Govt. Employees every year. H.B.A. to A.I.S. Officers: The Department provides fund for allotment of House Building Advances to AIS Officers every year. Ex-gratia payment: Fund is provided for payment to employees who died in harness. Other Matters dealt by the Department: T.A.: Dealing with T.A. claim as per TA Rules. Mileage Allowance is also included in the TA/DA for different types of vehicles used for official tours. House Rent Allowance: The Department conveys approval to claim on House Rent Allowance as per rate fixed by Finance (P.R.) Department vide No. F(PR)48/2009/1, dated 17th September, 2009. Write Off: All matters relating to write off has to be approved by this Department. Arrear Pay: All claims for arrear pay has to be approved by this Department. Facilities of Ministers, Parliamentary Secretaries, Chairman, Co-Chairman, Vice-Chairman and Deputy Chairman: These orders/circulars are revised by this Department from time to time. L.T.C. (Leave Travel Concession). Refund of Revenue. Air Journeys: This Department also conveys approval for air journeys performed on Training, Study Tour, Medical Treatment, etc. List of Officers and Employees ( As in 25th August 2020) PDF 39.3 KB View Key Contacts Joint Secretary - S - 2687/9436108063 Under Secretary - S - 2709

title: Finance Budget Branch | Finance Department Government of Meghalaya
headings: Finance Budget Organisation Chart | Key Contacts
content: Finance Budget Branch Finance (Budget) mainly deals with the following matters Preparation and computerization of the State Budget and Budget Documents along with Finance Minister's Budget Speech and Presentation of thesame to the State Legislature during the Budget Session. Regularization of the Supplementary Demands/Supplementary Appropriations during the Assembly Session, if any. Regularization of the Excess Demands for Grants and Appropriations during the Assembly Session, if any. Allocation of LOA/LOC Annual Reconciliation and Verification of Expenditure C. A. G Reports, Appropriation Accounts and Finance Accounts. The Department is headed by the Addl. Chief Secretary, Finance and is assisted by the Principal Secretary, Secretary, Joint Secretary, Deputy Secretary and Under Secretary and other Subordinate Officers including the Superintendent and Staff.The duties and responsibilities of the officers and employees are as per rules stipulated by the Meghalaya Secretariat Manual of Office Procedures,1993.The Superintendent is responsible for supervising and maintaining the general efficiency in the Branch, and is assisted by the Upper Division Assistants, Lower Division Assistants and Typists. The rules, regulations, Instructions, manuals and records, held by it or under its control or used by its employees for discharging its functions: Budget Manual of the Government of Meghalaya Volume I Meghalaya Contingency Fund Rules, 1972 Instructions regarding issue of LOA/LOC Instructions regarding submission of Budget Estimates Instructions regarding opening of New Sub Head/Detailed Heads of Accounts. title: Finance Economic Affairs Branch | Finance Department Government of Meghalaya
headings: Ways and Means: | Matters related to Finance Commission | Institutional Finance | Monitoring and Loan Recovery Cell | Public Enterprises Branch: | Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Cell | Finance Economic Affairs Organisation Chart
content: Finance Economic Affairs Branch The Department is primarily meant for effecting proper financial administration in the State. The main functions of the Department are indicated below: Preparation of skeleton Budget in respect of Revenue Expenditure of the State. Preparation of forecast of resources. Watching the flow of revenue such as release of Art. 275 grants, share of Central Taxes, on-account payment of Central Assistance for State Plan Schemes, Ways and Means Advance for Centrally Sponsored Schemes, Central Sector Schemes, NLCPR, EAP and N.E.C. Plan Schemes. Watching the flow of receipts and out goings, finding out resources for the State and monitoring the reports on collection of taxes and loans. Watching the progress of small savings collection, claim of reimbursement from the Government of India by the Department concerned. Introduction and enforcement of Economy Measures, Financial Control and Discipline. Watching the share between the State Government and the District Councils on Motor Vehicles Tax/ Royalties on Minor/Major/Professional Tax etc. Watching the release of certain grants by Government of India and follow up action for preferring claims by the Department, such as Border Roads, Jails, Civil Defense and Home Guards, etc. Policy etc on Natural Calamities following on the recommendation of the Finance Commission and watching the release of Central share by the Government of India. Fixation of the rate of interest on various loans sanctioned by the State Government. Matter relating to Additional Resources Mobilization. Dearness Allowances etc. Financial matters. Dealing with outside file that come from Finance (EC) Department for the purpose of release of funds/additional requirements. Digital Payments & Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Cell. Civil Deposits & Treasury Current Account ADB Project on Supporting Human Capital Development in Meghalaya. FRBM Act. Monthly Civil Accounts. VDMS, IFMS, CPSMS Monthly Statement and Daily Reports on Receipt & Expenditure from DAT/TOs. State Government Guarantee Ways and Means: Watching and monitoring the daily cash balance position of the State Government. Monitoring the daily Advices from the ministry and Clearances memos from Reserve Bank of India on daily basis. Monitoring the report on investment of Cash Balance and Government of India Treasury Bills. Preparation of Monthly forecast on receipts and expenditure of the State Government. Arranging temporary Ways and Means. Advance either from the R.B.I. or from the Government of India in the event/likelihood of shortfall of cash position of the State and regulation of overdraft. Maintenance of ledgers for all loans raised from the market Government of India, L.I.G., G.I.C, N.C.D.C., N.A.B.A.R.D. etc. and arranging for timely repayment of principal and interest with a view to avoid penal interest. Make arrangement for floatation of market loan etc Investment in Government of India securities matters connected to. Scarcity of Coins and Demonetization of Currency Action whereon. Shortage of cash in the Banks, arrangement of remittances. Monthly closing balance statement from R.B.I. and the A.G. matters relating to. State Finance Secretary's Meeting convened by RBI/GOI. Matters related to Finance Commission Analysis of the trends in the receipts and expenditure of the respective Departments. Follow up action on the recommendation of Finance Commission Collect and update information on various items relating to state economy including financial working of the state enterprises. Collection and compilation of data/information and preparation of forecast of receipts and expenditure and memorandum for submission to the Finance Commission. State Finance Commission. Institutional Finance Act as Nodal Department between the Nationalized Banks and the State Government Department in respect of any matters between the State Government and the Banking Institution. Follow-up action for the expansion of banking network in the State for the purpose of increasing credit/deposit ratio opening of bank branches at different centres of the state. Liaison with all the Banking and Financial Institutions operating in the State Monitor and watch the progress of development in the implementation of State Government's link with Bank Finance. Matters involving all District Consultative Committee, State Level Bankers Committee and all other banking/financial institutional fora. Closely monitor and watch the implementation of the District Credit Plans and other bankable Scheme over and above linkages of Government sponsored schemes with bank finance for the improvement of the economic conditions of the poor people. Women Economic Empowerment through Financial Inclusion, Financial Inclusion Committee, Designing A2F Programme. PMEGP, PMMY, PMJDY, PMSBY, PMJJDY, APY, Stand Up India. Technical Committee for fixing the Scale of Finance. Monitoring and Loan Recovery Cell To take action to ensure flow of institutional credit in the State and closely monitoring the same investment in the flow of credit to the State. To interact with the Banking institution and other financial institution and to sort out problems investment in the flow of credit to the State. To monitor and watch the function and operation of Non Bank Financial Company (NBFC) in the State. Monitoring the expenditure on Non-Plan schemes. Monitoring the collection of Taxes, duties under different taxation and recoveries of loan and advances and measures for improvement. Monitoring the progress of sanction for implementation of expenditure under Non Plan /Plan. Monitoring monthly, quarterly return on: Collection of arrears and current demand of taxes and non tax revenue. Collection of arrears and current demand of loans and advances. Data collection, compilation for incorporation in the report of the comptrollerand Auditor General of India. Matters connected with short term loans for agricultural inputs and recovery loans sanctioned by the State Government to Government Department/Public Undertaking etc. Public Enterprises Branch: Monitor the functions and performance of all public enterprise establishments in the State with particular reference to the internal resources of the Public Enterprises and their contribution towards the State Plan. All matters relating to meeting etc. of the State Public Sector Undertakings, Government Agencies Companies where Finance Secretary is a Director/Member of the Board of Management. VRS to employees of SPSUs. Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Cell To study the Schemes, classify them and re-examine existing process flows and fund flow of the same To develop Web based IT applications and facilitate automation of process flow and funds flow. To monitor and supervise the implementation of DBT on regular basis. Any other related matters. All matters received in the branch are processed by the Assistant Research Officers/ Research Officers /Senior Research Officers/Assistants and put up for decision as per the Chart below Finance Economic Affairs Organisation Chart (opens the full-size chart in a new tab) Finance Economic Affairs Organisation Chart View full size (opens in a new tab) Download (JPG) Directory of its Officers and Employees: as on 2016-2017 PDF 22 KB View
